leadFirstAttempt: KeyError bytes for pre-manifest row; no acceptance/artifact emitted; corrected with actual schema and all40hashes/39available sizes recomputed

limitations.bootstrap_capture: Initial pwd, ls, sha256sum and cat manifest plus the inline authentication command were captured by tool responses only; not preserved as separate exact local command/stream records. All exited 0. No tool output truncation observed. Subsequent checks use capture.py with exact command, stdout, stderr and exit code.
limitations.scope: Read/hash/manual document review only; no application code execution/import, provider, model, network, PostgreSQL, repository helpers or subagents.
limitations.tool_display_truncation: Batched tool responses for read-candidate and read-facts-map exceeded the outer display budget. capture.py saved their complete stdout/stderr before display. Relevant candidate sections and current-source boundaries were then read in smaller captures; the source-facts outline was also captured. No claim of perfect tool-display capture is made.
limitations.final_sealing_capture: The final evidence-manifest creation and artifact-hash display command is preserved in seal-evidence.py, but its outer shell invocation/exit/streams are available only in the tool response. It runs after finalize-review capture closes so that the manifest can bind every nonempty prior output. Its hash display is not recursively included in the manifest.
limitations.bootstrap_exit_evidence: Bootstrap pwd, ls, sha256sum, cat packet-manifest and inline authentication/setup all returned exit 0 in tool responses. Separate exact local command/stream records for those bootstrap actions were omitted, not reconstructed.
limitations.check_capture_scope: Each *.command.json records exact subprocess argv, cwd, exit and stream file paths for the command run by capture.py. Corresponding *.stdout and *.stderr are complete local subprocess streams. File-writing shell wrappers are not independently reconstructed as command records.
limitations.empty_streams: Empty stderr files are retained but excluded from evidence-manifest because the requested binding is of nonempty own outputs.
